description: This file defines a React functional component for a user profile page. It manages fetching, displaying, updating profile data, and handling user logout, utilizing hooks and API calls.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches user profile data and updates state variables; invoked on component mount.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles form submission to update user profile; manages saving state and error handling.

methods.name: onLogout
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.
